description: While this node's FULL RESET CMD awaits its acknowledgement, a DATA-ONLY from the peer that would pass every test is discarded unused: no delivery and no acknowledgement. After the FULL RESET ACK the peer's data from FSN 0 is delivered.
note: As dts-arq/sync-test-1-fail-full-reset up to 156550: FSNs 0 and 1 delivered, RX LWE 2 and RX UWE 1; the peer's FSN 0 with TX WIN UWE fails Test 1, and the FULL RESET CMD goes at 151000, with dts.reset_wait/0.0.1.3 from 156550. At 161000 the peer sends a DATA-ONLY, FSN 2, C_PDU START and END, no window flag, with 'more' (2 blocks, EOT 20). Judged against the current edges it would pass: Tests 1 and 2 do not apply and Test 3 accepts FSN 2 (C-0798), which is RX LWE itself, so it would be delivered at once and acknowledged. But a RESET/WIN-RESYNC command of ours is pending, so regular data from the peer is discarded unused (C-1175; C-0257 suspends our own sending): no delivery and no acknowledgement, and since nothing is queued the burst end at 162000 starts nothing. At 171000 the peer's FULL RESET ACK ends the exchange: dts.reset_wait stops and the edges go back to the initial values (C-0822, C-0824). At 181000 the peer, also reset, sends FSN 0 'boot' with TX WIN UWE and LWE: in sync at the initial edges, delivered, and acknowledged with an ACK-ONLY, RX LWE 1, at 227000 (csma.vdcd_end to 191000, contention 36000). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap, a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes, an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a WARNING 12 and a PADDING 11. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU when one fits (C-0367, C-1154). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
